factions.name: Vanguard Coalition
factions.fact: The Vanguard Coalition is the dominant human military force, allied with the Solar Accord and the Iron Covenant, and at war with the Ashen Legion.

factions.name: Ashen Legion
factions.fact: The Ashen Legion is allied with the Void Collective and secretly supplied by the Eclipse Syndicate. They are at war with the Vanguard Coalition.

factions.name: Solar Accord
factions.fact: The Solar Accord supports the Celestial Order and distrusts the Void Collective. They are allied with the Vanguard Coalition.

factions.name: Iron Covenant
factions.fact: The Iron Covenant is neutral toward all factions except the Vanguard Coalition, with whom they have a trade agreement established at the Treaty of Bastion.

factions.name: Void Collective
factions.fact: The Void Collective seeks control of paracausal artifacts and caused the Void Breach near the Black Meridian.

factions.name: Verdant Swarm
factions.fact: The Verdant Swarm is hostile to every human faction and is controlled in part by the Heartseed, which Thorn Alpha possesses.

factions.name: Eclipse Syndicate
factions.fact: The Eclipse Syndicate secretly supplies the Ashen Legion and operates in the shadows. Shade-7 is their most known operative.

factions.name: Celestial Order
factions.fact: The Celestial Order studies paracausal phenomena and helped contain the Void Breach. Sage Elandra is their most prominent member.

locations.name: Helios Prime
locations.fact: Helios Prime is the seat of the Vanguard Coalition, defended by Lyra Voss during the Battle of Helios Prime, which ended in a Vanguard victory.

locations.name: Obsidian Reef
locations.fact: The Obsidian Reef is controlled by the Ashen Legion and contains the Nightforge. Warlord Kharos commands from here.

locations.name: New Dawn Station
locations.fact: New Dawn Station orbits Helios Prime and serves as a diplomatic hub. Commander Orion's ship the Dawnbreaker is docked here.

locations.name: Crystal Wastes
locations.fact: The Crystal Wastes contain large deposits of Radiant Shards that power Vanguard technology. They border the Verdant Depths.

locations.name: Verdant Depths
locations.fact: The Verdant Depths are home to the Verdant Swarm and border the Crystal Wastes. Thorn Alpha commands from here.

locations.name: Black Meridian
locations.fact: The Black Meridian is hidden inside a nebula. The Void Key opens gateways to it. The Void Breach occurred near here and it remains unstable.

locations.name: Iron Bastion
locations.fact: The Iron Bastion is the headquarters of the Iron Covenant and the site where the Treaty of Bastion was signed.

locations.name: Sunken Vault
locations.fact: The Sunken Vault contains ancient technology and is the hiding place of the Astral Crown, which Archon Veyl seeks.

locations.name: Aether Spire
locations.fact: The Aether Spire is maintained by the Celestial Order. Sage Elandra's ship the Silver Halo is stationed here.

locations.name: Ember Reach
locations.fact: Ember Reach was destroyed during the Red Eclipse when the Ashen Legion attacked. It no longer exists. The Ember Sigil was forged here before its destruction.

locations.name: Hollow Moon
locations.fact: The Hollow Moon contains abandoned laboratories where Sage Elandra led the expedition that recovered the Echo Prism.

locations.name: Silent Frontier
locations.fact: The Silent Frontier lies beyond charted space. No survivors reached Resonance Point. Ren Ashford deserted before the final approach and is the only member to return alive.

locations.name: Veil Station
locations.fact: Veil Station is a hidden Eclipse Syndicate outpost near the border of charted space. Shade-7 uses it as a base of operations.

locations.name: The Ashen Gate
locations.fact: The Ashen Gate is a fortified checkpoint controlled by the Ashen Legion on the route to the Silent Frontier. All ships passing through are logged.

locations.name: Resonance Point
locations.fact: Resonance Point is an anomalous region near the Silent Frontier where paracausal energy readings spiked just before the expedition disappeared.

characters.name: Commander Orion
characters.fact: Commander Orion leads the Vanguard Coalition and mentored Lyra Voss. Marshal Drax once saved his life. He survived the Red Eclipse.
characters.personality: formal, burdened by command, deeply loyal
characters.speaking_style: measured, authoritative, rarely uses contractions, references duty and sacrifice

characters.name: Lyra Voss
characters.fact: Lyra Voss serves the Vanguard Coalition and defended Helios Prime. Her sister Captain Mira died during the Red Eclipse. She was mentored by Commander Orion.
characters.personality: driven, grieving, fiercely loyal, haunted by Mira's death
characters.speaking_style: direct, clipped, deflects personal questions, becomes cold when Mira is mentioned

characters.name: Warlord Kharos
characters.fact: Warlord Kharos commands the Ashen Legion from the Obsidian Reef. He is the personal enemy of Commander Orion and commanded Ashen forces at Helios Prime.
characters.speaking_style: cold, declarative, never explains himself, speaks in short sentences

characters.name: Sage Elandra
characters.fact: Sage Elandra studies paracausal artifacts and recovered the Echo Prism from the Hollow Moon. She helped contain the Void Breach and possesses the Echo Prism.
characters.personality: scholarly, cautious, fascinated by the unknown, meticulous
characters.speaking_style: precise, uses technical language, asks clarifying questions, thinks aloud

characters.name: Marshal Drax
characters.fact: Marshal Drax leads the Iron Covenant and once saved Commander Orion's life. He signed the Treaty of Bastion. He distrusts all paracausal involvement.
characters.personality: pragmatic, blunt, honor-bound, deeply skeptical of anything paracausal
characters.speaking_style: terse, plain language, no metaphors, dislikes long conversations

characters.name: Shade-7
characters.fact: Shade-7 works for the Eclipse Syndicate and stole the Starcore Lens before the Nightforge Awakening. They operate from Veil Station and their ship the Shadow Whisper has evaded Vanguard patrols. Shade-7 knows what the Silent Frontier Expedition found.
characters.personality: evasive, mercenary, amused by others discomfort, self-serving
characters.speaking_style: deflects direct questions, half-truths, dry humor, never confirms anything directly

characters.name: Archon Veyl
characters.fact: Archon Veyl commands the Void Collective, caused the Void Breach, and seeks the Astral Crown hidden in the Sunken Vault. He possesses the Void Key.
characters.personality: fanatical, serene, utterly certain, views all events as inevitable
characters.speaking_style: slow, deliberate, speaks as if reciting scripture, never raises voice

characters.name: Captain Mira
characters.fact: Captain Mira is dead. She died during the Red Eclipse when the Ashen Legion attacked Ember Reach. She was Lyra Voss's sister. She cannot speak, appear, or be referenced as living.

characters.name: Thorn Alpha
characters.fact: Thorn Alpha leads the Verdant Swarm and possesses the Heartseed which controls portions of the swarm. They attacked mining operations during the Crystal Campaign.
characters.personality: alien, territorial, views humans as a blight
characters.speaking_style: minimal language, biological metaphors, refers to humans collectively never individually

characters.name: Admiral Sorel
characters.fact: Admiral Sorel commands the Solar Accord fleet and distrusts Archon Veyl personally after the Void Breach. She authorized the Silent Frontier Expedition and has never disclosed why.
characters.personality: cautious, politically savvy, carries guilt about the expedition
characters.speaking_style: measured, hedges statements, changes subject when the expedition is mentioned

characters.name: Dr. Cassian Vorne
characters.fact: Dr. Cassian Vorne led the Silent Frontier Expedition as its chief scientist. He is dead. His last transmission mentioned a structure at Resonance Point that should not exist. He cannot be referenced as living.

characters.name: Ren Ashford
characters.fact: Ren Ashford is a junior Iron Covenant scout who survived the Silent Frontier Expedition by deserting before the final approach to Resonance Point. He is the only survivor. He lives in hiding at the Iron Bastion and refuses to speak about what he saw.
characters.personality: traumatized, paranoid, deeply ashamed of deserting
characters.speaking_style: fragmented sentences, avoids eye contact, flinches at mentions of the frontier

characters.name: Lira Dawn
characters.fact: Lira Dawn is an Eclipse Syndicate information broker based at Veil Station. She sold navigational data to the Silent Frontier Expedition and knows the route they took.
characters.personality: professional, detached, everything has a price
characters.speaking_style: formal, transactional, speaks in terms of value and trade

characters.name: The Warden
characters.fact: The Warden is an unknown entity encountered only through fragmented transmissions originating from the Silent Frontier. Its faction and nature are unknown. It refers to the expedition members in past tense.
characters.personality: unknown, speaks in riddles, aware of the player
characters.speaking_style: fragmented, poetic, unsettling, refers to events before they happen

artifacts.name: Astral Crown
artifacts.fact: The Astral Crown can amplify paracausal energy and is hidden in the Sunken Vault. Archon Veyl seeks it actively.

artifacts.name: Starcore Lens
artifacts.fact: The Starcore Lens can locate ancient relics. Shade-7 stole it before the Nightforge Awakening and currently possesses it.

artifacts.name: Ember Sigil
artifacts.fact: The Ember Sigil unlocks the Nightforge and was forged on Ember Reach before its destruction. Its current location is unknown.

artifacts.name: Nightforge
artifacts.fact: The Nightforge can create artifact weapons and is located at the Obsidian Reef, controlled by the Ashen Legion.

artifacts.name: Heartseed
artifacts.fact: The Heartseed controls portions of the Verdant Swarm and is currently possessed by Thorn Alpha.

artifacts.name: Void Key
artifacts.fact: The Void Key opens gateways to the Black Meridian and is currently possessed by Archon Veyl.

artifacts.name: Echo Prism
artifacts.fact: The Echo Prism stores memories and is currently possessed by Sage Elandra, who recovered it from the Hollow Moon.

artifacts.name: Radiant Shards
artifacts.fact: Radiant Shards power Vanguard technology and are mined in the Crystal Wastes.

artifacts.name: Resonance Beacon
artifacts.fact: The Resonance Beacon was carried by Dr. Cassian Vorne on the Silent Frontier Expedition. Its signal still transmits from Resonance Point. No one has retrieved it.

artifacts.name: Vorne's Log
artifacts.fact: Vorne's Log is Dr. Cassian Vorne's personal research journal, recovered by Ren Ashford before he deserted. It contains partial notes about what Vorne found at Resonance Point. Ren refuses to share it.

events.name: The Red Eclipse
events.outcome: Ember Reach destroyed, Captain Mira killed, Vanguard survived
events.fact: The Red Eclipse was a major war in which the Ashen Legion attacked and destroyed Ember Reach. Captain Mira died. Commander Orion survived. This is the defining trauma of the Vanguard Coalition.

events.name: Battle of Helios Prime
events.fact: The Battle of Helios Prime ended in a Vanguard Coalition victory. Kharos commanded Ashen forces. Lyra Voss defended the station. This cemented Lyra's reputation.

events.name: Discovery of the Echo Prism
events.outcome: Echo Prism recovered by Sage Elandra
events.fact: Sage Elandra led the expedition that recovered the Echo Prism from the Hollow Moon. The laboratories there were abandoned and showed signs of paracausal interference.

events.name: The Nightforge Awakening
events.outcome: Nightforge activated, Starcore Lens stolen by Shade-7 beforehand
events.fact: The Ember Sigil activated the Nightforge at the Obsidian Reef. Shade-7 stole the Starcore Lens before this event occurred, suggesting foreknowledge.

events.name: The Crystal Campaign
events.outcome: Vanguard secured Radiant Shards, Verdant Swarm pushed back
events.fact: The Crystal Campaign secured Radiant Shards for the Vanguard in the Crystal Wastes. Thorn Alpha attacked mining operations during it, causing significant casualties.

events.name: The Void Breach
events.outcome: Contained but Black Meridian remains unstable
events.fact: Archon Veyl caused the Void Breach near the Black Meridian. The Celestial Order helped contain it. Admiral Sorel coordinated the Solar Accord response. The Black Meridian remains unstable.

events.name: The Treaty of Bastion
events.fact: The Treaty of Bastion was signed at the Iron Bastion between the Vanguard Coalition and the Iron Covenant, establishing trade rights. Both Commander Orion and Marshal Drax were present.

events.name: The Silent Frontier Expedition
events.outcome: All hands lost except Ren Ashford who deserted. Cause unknown.
events.fact: The Silent Frontier Expedition traveled beyond charted space to Resonance Point under Dr. Cassian Vorne. Admiral Sorel authorized it. Ren Ashford deserted before the final approach and is the only survivor. Vorne's last transmission mentioned a structure that should not exist. The Resonance Beacon still transmits from the frontier. Shade-7 sold navigational data to the expedition through Lira Dawn.

events.name: The Starcore Theft
events.fact: Shade-7 stole the Starcore Lens just before the Nightforge Awakening, suggesting the Eclipse Syndicate had advance knowledge of the event. The Ashen Legion has never publicly acknowledged the theft.

events.name: The Veil Accord
events.outcome: Expedition received navigational data, Eclipse Syndicate received unknown payment
events.fact: The Veil Accord was a secret transaction in which Lira Dawn sold navigational data for the Silent Frontier route to the expedition. What the Eclipse Syndicate received in return has never been disclosed.

ships.name: Dawnbreaker
ships.fact: The Dawnbreaker belongs to Commander Orion and is docked at New Dawn Station.

ships.name: Nightfall
ships.fact: The Nightfall belongs to Warlord Kharos and is stationed at the Obsidian Reef.

ships.name: Silver Halo
ships.fact: The Silver Halo belongs to Sage Elandra and is stationed at the Aether Spire.

ships.name: Iron Resolve
ships.fact: The Iron Resolve belongs to Marshal Drax and is docked at the Iron Bastion.

ships.name: Shadow Whisper
ships.fact: The Shadow Whisper belongs to Shade-7 and has evaded Vanguard patrols. Its current location is unknown.

ships.name: Meridian Cross
ships.fact: The Meridian Cross belongs to Admiral Sorel and is stationed at Helios Prime.

mystery_clues.clue: Ren Ashford is the only survivor of the Silent Frontier Expedition. He deserted before the final approach to Resonance Point. He possesses Vorne's Log but refuses to share it. He knows what the beacon is transmitting but will not say.

Shade-7 sold navigational data to the expedition through Lira Dawn. Shade-7 knows what the expedition found because the Eclipse Syndicate intercepted Vorne's final transmission. Shade-7 will not reveal this for free.

Admiral Sorel authorized the expedition without disclosing the real reason. She received an anomalous paracausal reading from Resonance Point six months before the expedition departed. She has suppressed this information.

The Echo Prism stores memories. Sage Elandra recovered a fragment from the Hollow Moon laboratories that appears to contain a memory of Resonance Point from before the expedition. She has not yet decoded it fully.

The Warden communicates through the Resonance Beacon. It refers to the expedition members in past tense. It knows the player is coming. It says the structure at Resonance Point has existed longer than the Vanguard Coalition.
Lira Dawn knows the exact route the expedition took. She also knows the Eclipse Syndicate received a paracausal artifact as payment for the navigational data. She will sell this information.

Commander Orion authorized Vanguard support for the Silent Frontier Expedition. He knows it traveled beyond charted space to Resonance Point under Dr. Cassian Vorne, that all hands were lost except one deserter, and that Admiral Sorel authorized it.
